name: Pact Bounded Payment
description: A Chipnet BCH policy output that routes payments to one committed recipient under a per-payment cap, preserves the remaining funded balance, and lets the owner recover after a timestamp.

agent.name: Scoped agent
agent.description: Can spend one policy UTXO only to the committed recipient and within the per-payment cap.

owner.name: Policy owner
owner.description: Receives the locked BCH after the recovery timestamp.

pay.name: Make bounded payment
pay.description: Send BCH to the committed recipient and return the remaining policy funds to the same covenant.

reclaim.name: Recover policy funds
reclaim.description: After the recovery timestamp, route the remaining policy value to the owner's fixed BCH address.

payTransaction.name: Pact payment
payTransaction.description: Pay $(<paymentSatoshis>) satoshis to the policy recipient.

reclaimTransaction.name: Pact recovery
reclaimTransaction.description: Return the policy balance to its owner after the recovery timestamp.

policyPayInput.name: Pact policy input
policyPayInput.description: The policy UTXO being spent under its recipient and amount constraints.

policyReclaimInput.name: Pact policy input
policyReclaimInput.description: The policy UTXO being recovered after its timestamp.

recipientOutput.name: Approved recipient
recipientOutput.description: The payment to the recipient committed by the policy.

policyContinuationOutput.name: Remaining policy balance
policyContinuationOutput.description: Returns the remaining satoshis to the same Pact policy.

ownerRecoveryOutput.name: Owner recovery
ownerRecoveryOutput.description: Returns the remaining BCH to the owner's committed locking script.

pactPolicyLockingScript.name: Pact payment policy
pactPolicyLockingScript.description: Enforces the fixed recipient, per-payment cap, one-input spending, a same-script balance continuation, fixed transaction fee, and delayed owner recovery. Payment signing remains available to the agent key after the recovery time; the recovery time makes the owner branch available.

recipientLockingScript.name: Approved recipient
recipientLockingScript.description: P2PKH output to the address committed by the policy.

ownerLockingScript.name: Policy owner
ownerLockingScript.description: P2PKH output to the address committed by the policy.

agentKey.name: Ephemeral agent signing key
agentKey.description: Generated by the Chipnet XO test engine for this policy; it is not a user's wallet key.

recipientLockingBytecode.name: Approved recipient
recipientLockingBytecode.description: P2PKH locking bytecode for the only address the policy may pay.

ownerLockingBytecode.name: Owner recovery address
ownerLockingBytecode.description: P2PKH locking bytecode that receives recovered BCH.

perPaymentCapSatoshis.name: Per-payment cap
perPaymentCapSatoshis.description: Maximum satoshis allowed in one recipient output.

expiryTimestamp.name: Recovery timestamp
expiryTimestamp.description: Unix timestamp after which the owner recovery path is available.

inputSatoshis.name: Policy input value
inputSatoshis.description: Satoshis in the selected contract UTXO; the contract verifies the constructed outputs against it.

paymentSatoshis.name: Payment amount
paymentSatoshis.description: Satoshis paid to the committed recipient.

policyFeeSatoshis.name: Fixed transaction fee
policyFeeSatoshis.description: Exact satoshi fee committed into this policy output.

dustLimitSatoshis.name: Minimum BCH output value
dustLimitSatoshis.description: Minimum satoshis for the payment, continuation, and recovery outputs.
